correctness.rationale: For directed cyclic triple a→b→c→a in a (4t+3)-vertex doubly regular tournament, each external d is a common in/out-neighbor of 3,1,or0 cycle edges. Double count over three pairs gives 6t=4t+2h, hence exactly h=t outside common dominating or dominated vertices. For t>=1, a cyclic triangle perimeter is the boundary of three individually transitive directed two-paths through an apex; a transitive triangle perimeter is one allowed path boundary. The triangles C(r,i,j) rooted at r form a unimodular integral basis of the 1-cycle lattice of the complete underlying graph, and coefficient sum ≤||z||_1, giving B with ∂B=z and ||B||_1≤3||z||_1. At t=0 a directed triangle has Ω2=0 so H1=Z. Independently enumerated Paley7,11,19 pair-neighbor counts and exactly t common apices of every directed triangle.
